species: human (osteoblasts, chondrocytes, periodontal ligament fibroblasts); mouse (N2a neuroblastoma cells)
readout_other: MTS colorimetric cell viability/metabolic activity assay; trypan blue exclusion cell counting (proliferation)
direction_notes: Combined ultrasound+light stimulation increased metabolic activity in human osteoblasts; light alone (not ultrasound alone) increased metabolic activity in human chondrocytes; ultrasound alone did not significantly change metabolic activity in any of the four cell types tested, and neither individual nor combined stimuli affected human periodontal ligament fibroblasts or mouse-derived neuroblastoma (N2a) cells.
safety_notes: The safety of the device was confirmed as there was no cell death for any cell type, no cell contamination during stimulation, and no alterations in cellular morphology were detected during or after individual or simultaneous stimulation; temperature rise during stimulation was below 1.0 degC.

exposures.label: Ultrasound stimulation of cultured cells (osteoblasts, chondrocytes, periodontal ligament fibroblasts, N2a neuroblastoma cells)

target.label: human osteoblasts (hFOB), human chondrocytes, human periodontal ligament fibroblasts, and mouse-derived neuroblastoma (N2a Tau P301L) cells in 12-well culture plates

device.manufacturer: PI Ceramics GmbH (piezoelectric disc); custom-built stimulation device
device.model: Custom multi-modal stimulation device with PIC255 piezoelectric disc (ref 000084902)

timing.protocol_description: Piezoelectric disc (PIC255, 3-mm diameter, 2-mm thickness) immersed at the centre of each well, 8 mm from the cells; ultrasound applied at 1.0 MHz, 100 mW/cm2, for 5 min, once daily for three consecutive days, with cells collected for viability/proliferation analysis the day after the last stimulation session. Conditions also included PBM alone (810 nm, 7.5 mW/cm2, 5 min), combined PBM+US, and device-off controls.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Cells were stimulated for three days, in triplicate, and collected for analysis on the day after the last stimulation session.

The safety of the device was confirmed as there was no cell death for any cell type. The sterilization conditions of this device are compatible with the cell culture environment since no cell contamination occurred during the stimulation procedure.
